title: The maximal-ideal multiplication kernel dies at a later stage of a flat colimit
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a nonempty directed preorder. For each $i\in\Lambda$, let $A_i$ be a Noetherian local commutative ring, $B_i$ a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and $N_i$ a finite $B_i$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $A$, $B$, and $N$ be functors from $\Lambda$ respectively to commutative rings, commutative rings, and abelian groups, with these objects and transition maps $\alpha_f$, $\beta_f$, and $\eta_f$ for $f:i\to j$. Let $\varphi_i:A_i\to B_i$ be ring maps such that $\beta_f\varphi_i=\varphi_j\alpha_f$, and suppose $\eta_f(bx)=\beta_f(b)\eta_f(x)$. Let $A_\infty$, $B_\infty$, and $N_\infty$ be their specified categorical colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], with coprojections $a_i$, $b_i$, and $n_i$. Suppose a ring map $\psi:A_\infty\to B_\infty$ satisfies $\psi a_i=b_i\varphi_i$, and $N_\infty$ is a $B_\infty$-module satisfying $n_i(bx)=b_i(b)n_i(x)$. Assume $N_\infty$ is flat over $A_\infty$ through $\psi$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. For every fixed $i$, put $I=\mathfrak m_{A_i}$. Then there are an index $j$, a morphism $f:i\to j$, and an additive map $\theta:I\otimes_{A_i}N_i\to (I A_j)\otimes_{A_j}N_j$, where $I A_j=I.\mathrm{map}(\alpha_f)$ and the module structures are through $\varphi_i$ and $\varphi_j$, such that $\theta(a\otimes x)=\alpha_f(a)\otimes\eta_f(x)$ for every $a\in I$, $x\in N_i$, and $\theta(k)=0$ whenever $k$ lies in the kernel of multiplication $I\otimes_{A_i}N_i\to N_i$, $a\otimes x\mapsto\varphi_i(a)x$. No locality of the structure or transition maps and no localization or tensor base-change assumptions are required. The forgetful functor from commutative rings to sets is assumed to preserve the specified colimit of the first ring diagram A.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-tensor-kernel-generators] at i with I equal to the maximal ideal. Obtain a finite set s in N_i tensor I spanning the multiplication kernel over B_i. Transport s through tensor commutativity to I tensor N_i.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-ideal-kernel-descent] to this finite set, obtaining j, f and the additive map theta with its pure-tensor formula and vanishing on the finite set. Supply the explicit PreservesColimit instance for A to this application.

Conjugate theta by tensor commutativity on both ends, so B_i and B_j act on the left tensor factors. The pure-tensor formula and scalar compatibility of N give tau(b*k)=beta_f(b)*tau(k) on pure tensors, hence on all tensors by tensor induction. Span induction shows tau kills the B_i-span of s. Every multiplication-kernel element is in this span by step 1; tensor commutativity is injective, so theta kills the original element.

proof_origin.place: Tag 00R6, the same finite-generation/descent route, with tensor commutativity used to put the larger-ring action on the left. The explicit preservation hypothesis expresses the algebraic ring colimit used in Tag 00R6 and prevents the large-index/small-ring categorical-colimit error.

theorem exists_stage_maximal_kernel_vanishes
    {Λ : Type u} [Preorder Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty Λ]
    (A : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) (B : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{w})
    (N : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{z}) [HasColimit A] [HasColimit B] [HasColimit N]
    [PreservesColimit A (forget CommRingCat.{v})]
    [∀ i, IsLocalRing (A.obj i)]
    [∀ i, IsNoetherianRing (A.obj i)] [∀ i, IsNoetherianRing (B.obj i)]
    [∀ i, Module (B.obj i) (N.obj i)] [∀ i, Module.Finite (B.obj i) (N.obj i)]
    (φ : ∀ i, A.obj i →+* B.obj i)
    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j),
      (B.map f).hom.comp (φ i) = (φ j).comp (A.map f).hom)
    (hscalar : ∀ (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j) (b : B.obj i) (x : N.obj i),
      (N.map f).hom (b • x) = (B.map f).hom b • (N.map f).hom x)
    (ψ : (colimit A : CommRingCat.{v}) →+* (colimit B : CommRingCat.{w}))
    (hψ : ∀ i, ψ.comp (colimit.ι A i).hom = (colimit.ι B i).hom.comp (φ i))
    [Module (colimit B : CommRingCat.{w}) (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{z})]
    (hlimitScalar : ∀ (i : Λ) (b : B.obj i) (x : N.obj i),
      (colimit.ι N i).hom (b • x) = (colimit.ι B i).hom b • (colimit.ι N i).hom x)
    (hflat : letI := Module.compHom (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{z}) ψ
      Module.Flat (colimit A : CommRingCat.{v}) (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{z})) (i : Λ) :
    ∃ (j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j),
      letI := Module.compHom (N.obj i) (φ i)
      letI := Module.compHom (N.obj j) (φ j)
      let I := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A.obj i)
      ∃ θ : I ⊗[A.obj i] N.obj i →+
          (I.map (A.map f).hom) ⊗[A.obj j] N.obj j,
        (∀ (a : I) (x : N.obj i), θ (a ⊗ₜ[A.obj i] x) =
          (⟨(A.map f).hom a, Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (A.map f).hom a.property⟩ :
            I.map (A.map f).hom) ⊗ₜ[A.obj j] (N.map f).hom x) ∧
        (∀ k : I ⊗[A.obj i] N.obj i,
          TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.lsmul (A.obj i) (N.obj i)).comp I.subtype) k = 0 →
            θ k = 0)
